item.tib: khro bo rol pa dug gsum gtan sprug gis rgyud las phur bu stong gi rtse bzlog
item.coloph: phur bu stong gi rtse bzlog (zlog) zhes bya ba 'di ni/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ston pa gshen rab kyis/ g.yung drung lha yi skad du/ stag la me 'bar la bstan/ stag la me 'bar gyis/ stag gzig rig pa gsal la bstan/ des rgya gar gyi grub thob lha bdag sngags grol la bstan/ des zhang zhung stong rgyung la bstan/ des gnyan li shu stag ring la bstan/ des phyi rabs don du bka' rgya gdab/ des nas se ku b+han d+he'i (d+his) bton/ de nas sgrub gshen rnams la brgyud/ sems can rnams kyi bar chod bsal/ mthar yang bla med 'bras bu thob//
